headline: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: The committee heard testimony on two resolutions to rezone some apartment properties as hotel districts for vacation rentals, then recessed to August 19, 2026.
meeting.recap: Resolutions 26-129 and 26-130 would send proposed bills to the Maui Planning Commission to rezone some apartment properties as hotel districts so vacation rentals can continue.[[0:04:52]] Resolution 26-129 covers properties expected to be affected by sea level rise by 2100.[[0:05:21]] Resolution 26-130 covers one Kīhei property and the Makai Sunset Inn in Lahaina.[[0:05:58]] A Kīhei Bay Vista board member said they have lost eight vehicles to flash flooding in 13 years.[[0:20:54]] An attorney for condo associations said going to court is one option if the criteria are applied unevenly.[[1:15:00]] The Office of Hawaiian Affairs testified against both resolutions.[[1:22:24]] A Lahaina resident who supports wildfire survivors testified against both resolutions.[[2:15:15]] The resident said the resolutions go against Bill 9's purpose of reclaiming housing in apartment districts.[[2:20:03]] The chair recessed the meeting to August 19, 2026, at 9 a.m.[[2:26:18]] About a dozen testifiers were still waiting to speak.[[2:26:53]]
decided: The chair recessed the meeting to August 19, 2026, at 9 a.m., before testimony was finished.
meeting.next: Public testimony will continue when the committee reconvenes.

moments.q: "I will be ending this meeting at 11.45."
"And do we litigate on a constitutional basis..."
Office of Hawaiian Affairs opposes both resolutions
